Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 01.10.2024 AD-35 Court No.29 TN (Rejected)
 CRM (A) 3509 of 2024

In Re:- An application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal  Procedure read with Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with Bhagbanpur  Police Station Case No. 146 of 2024 dated 14.06.2024 under Sections 498A/307/34 of the IPC & 3/4 of the D.P. Act.

entities.text: Bhagbanpur  Police Station Case No. 146 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
And  In the matter of: Sri Gurupada Patra  .... petitioner  Mr. Indrajit Chatterjee  ....for the petitioner  Ms. Sonali Das,
 Ms. Trisha Rakshit  ....for the State  1.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. Considering the nature of the injury and the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure which directly implicates the petitioner of physical and mental torture and demand for dowry prima facie established, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
3. Accordingly, this application for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected.
4. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
